title: The actual subgradient steps telescope weighted objective gaps · Optlib prerequisite
target_statement: Let f be globally G-Lipschitz. For sequences x_k,v_k and nonnegative real steps a_k, suppose v_k supports f at x_k and x_(k+1)=x_k−a_k v_k for every k. For every comparator z and every N≥0, the weighted objective gaps obey the displayed bound, including the terminal squared distance.

signatures:
theorem sum_weighted_gap_le {f : E → ℝ} {G : ℝ≥0} {x g : ℕ → E} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : LipschitzWith G f) (ha : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k)
    (hs : ∀ k, SupportsAt f (x k) (g k))
    (hx : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = x k - a k • g k) (z : E) (N : ℕ) :
    2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, a k * (f (x k) - f z)) ≤
      ‖x 0 - z‖ ^ 2 + (G : ℝ) ^ 2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (a k) ^ 2) - ‖x N - z‖ ^ 2
